title: Hedera Flight Checkn
tagline: System to safely and efficiently create electronic boarding passes.
description: System to safely and efficiently create electronic boarding passes. It uses Hedera SDK to create a smart contract to check in a passenger and create a boarding pass. This allows for checking at anytime before the flight has departed instead of being restricted to 2hrs before departure.
how_its_made: It uses Hedera SDK to create a smart contract to check in a passenger and create a boarding pass. The app uses next js and typescript and the contracts are written with hederas node sdk. The users is prompted to enter their name and confirmation and that is stored on chain for lookup.
auto_summary: A Next.js app records airline passenger check-in data on Hedera using the JavaScript SDK.
